title: BizFlood Excess over NFIP — Attachment Points Across the BizFlood Program
content:
Within BizFlood Commercial Flood Policies (Surplus Lines), one tier — BizFlood Excess over NFIP — is written above the limits of an NFIP General Property Form policy on each location. Every other tier is written as primary coverage, with no attachment.

## Attachment schedule (USD per location)

| Tier | Written excess of NFIP | Building attachment per location | Contents attachment per location |
|---|---|---|---|
| BizFlood Building | No | 0 | 0 |
| BizFlood Building and Contents | No | 0 | 0 |
| BizFlood Building, Contents and Business Income | No | 0 | 0 |
| BizFlood Excess over NFIP | Yes | 500000 | 500000 |
| BizFlood Multi-Location | No | 0 | 0 |
| BizFlood Large Property | No | 0 | 0 |

An attachment of 0 means the tier is primary: it does not sit above another policy.

## Points of reading

- On BizFlood Excess over NFIP the building coverage attaches at 500000 per location and the contents coverage attaches at 500000 per location.
- The attachment is stated per location, not per policy.
- On the five primary tiers there is no building attachment and no contents attachment.
